faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Technology Development Board Assistant Law Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Technology Development Board Assistant Law Officer posts is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Law Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an LLB or Integrated LLB degree along with a minimum of 5 years of relevant field experience, specifically in Corporate/Company Law, to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Law Officer position is 40 years as of 01st July 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Law Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Assistant Law Officer position by the Technology Development Board in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Law Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Law Officer post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 90,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Technology Development Board Assistant Law Officer recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Assistant Law Officer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Assistant Law Officer posts in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Assistant Law Officer position?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Assistant Law Officer post will be based on an interview conducted by the Technology Development Board.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Technology Development Board, which is www.tdb.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates along with the filled application form.
